about: The round-trip axis of the coverage ledger (docs/design/graph-integrity.md G9.2): what a mod's own instances get from the app's shared surfaces, and what the parts the framework lends draw of a mod's data. Each row is checked natively through a mod's path (scripts/qa/mods/qa.conformance: its own kind of each concept the shared surfaces show) on a build. `surfaces`: each shared surface, what it does for a mod's instance, and a row per concept it shows. `lentParts`: a row per lent part: it draws the mod's data in the mod's own surface as the app draws its own. A row is {status: 'open'} until checked, then {status: 'green', build, date, proof} (proof: a file in this repository with an optional anchor), or {status: 'none', why} where that surface does not show the concept. scripts/roundtrip.mjs prints it; tests/roundtrip.test.mjs keeps it in step with the lent parts and the conformance mod.

sidebarRow.what: its chat is a row in the sidebar's group for its agent, after the app's own groups, drawn as the app's rows, with its mark

Thread.note: its row with its mark (the badge its rules give it), after the fix that draws marks on the framework's rows

sidebarGroup.what: a group in the sidebar named for its agent, after the app's own groups

Agent.note: the app's group headings carry no icon, its own as the agents' ones

rowMenu.what: the row's menu offers the shared actions the chat supports, each the user's own act

Thread.note: checked with the test agent's chats: the menu offered Archive, which took the chat out of its group; not driven again (a scripted press does not open the kit's menu)

rowWaiting.what: its chat's row says the chat waits for the user while it does (its status, set by its provider while one of its requests is pending)

Thread.note: the waiting dot while its requests were pending

unread.what: a finished reply leaves its row unread until its view is shown

Thread.note: unread until its view was shown, then read (the dot itself with the test agent, GI2b: a waiting chat shows the waiting dot first)

openView.what: a row opens its chat to the view the mod registered for its kind

palette.what: the palette's Agents' chats finds its chat and opens its view

Thread.note: with the test agent's chats: its Agents' chats result opened its view; not driven again (the QA account's palette lists its own chats)

windowOpen.what: Window.open of its chat opens its view

card.what: a pending request shows as the lent card in its chat's view and is answered there, as the user
